messages:
From: John Sato <john.sato@acme.inc>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — scheduling

Hi Priya,

Thanks for moving this forward. We're excited to get the hands-on working session scheduled for the POC. Our team is available the week of May 24–28 for a 3-hour block where we can do prompt review, routing checks, and a short load sanity run.

A few asks up front:
- Can you send a proposed agenda and any pre-reads?
- We may need to run a light load test from our end — what traffic profile should we exercise?
- Please include the AE and solutions engineer on the invite.

Best,
John
John Sato
Engineering Manager, Acme Inc.
john.sato@acme.inc

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: John Sato <john.sato@acme.inc>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — scheduling

John — thanks, great to hear. Proposed approach and quick options below.

High-level agenda (we'll attach a PDF pre-read):
1) 15m introductions & goals alignment
2) 30m prompt walkthrough & routing plan review
3) 60m hands-on prompt lab (iterative tuning)
4) 30m load sanity plan + test run (short burst)
5) 15m wrap + next steps/action items

Availability windows (Pacific):
- Tue 25 May: 09:00–12:00 or 13:00–16:00
- Wed 26 May: 10:00–13:00
- Thu 27 May: 08:00–11:00

Pre-reads we'll attach:
- POC-Kickoff-Agenda-v2.pdf (agenda + objectives)
- hands-on-checklist.md (what we need from your side: API keys, sample prompt set, test dataset)
- loadtest-plan.csv (sample traffic profile)

Quick asks for your ops/eng team before session:
- A short representative prompt set (10–20 prompts) and expected outputs
- IPs or CIDR for load test origin if you want us to whitelist anything
- Any corporate firewall/VPN constraints we should know about

Marissa, Ben — looping you in to confirm who from our side covers prompt lab vs. infra checks.

I'll hold Tuesday 25 09:00–12:00 tentatively until I hear back.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

From: John Sato <john.sato@acme.inc>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: eng-team@acme.inc
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — scheduling

Thanks Priya — Tue 25 morning looks tight for a few folks. Can we move to Wed 26 May 11:00–14:00 PT instead? That would give our ops lead time to assemble the sample prompts and a small test runner.

We will:
- Drop the 20-prompt set in the shared drive you linked by Mon EOD
- Share expected output examples (JSON)
- Provide a static IP for the short load bursts (will send by Tue)

Also, please include Ben on the call — he'll handle pricing/commit questions post-session.

Appreciate it,
John

John — confirmed for Wed 26 May, 11:00–14:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to the group. Final logistics and prework below.

Attachments (also uploaded to shared drive):

- 11:45–12:45 — hands-on prompt lab (Priya + Marissa)

- John/Acme: place sample prompt set + expected outputs in the Drive link by Mon 17:00 PT
- Acme ops: send static IP for whitelist by Tue 12:00 PT
- Ben: prepare brief pricing/commit slide (5 minutes) for wrap
